description:
SHARE THIS to someone on YOUR TEAM! @red_lifecoach

The power of a TEAM is GREATER than the power of a single INDIVIDUAL.

Obstacles seem SMALLER, and the impossible becomes POSSIBLE TOGETHER.

No one can do it on their own. #MAXOUT
transcript: Like a small boat on the ocean Sending big waves into motion Like how a single word can make a heart open I might only have one batch, but I can make an explosion And all those things I didn't say Were wrecking balls inside my brain I will scream out loud tonight Can you hear my voice this time? This is my fight song Take back my life song Prove I'm right song My power's turned on I'll be strong I'll play my fight song And I don't really care
